about: The home region of a card: of the ordered region list, the region id whose SHA3-256(label || region id || UID) is the greatest, compared as big-endian bytes (on a tie, the earlier region). The region ids are their ASCII bytes, the UID its 7 bytes. Every other region refuses the card with the reason wrong-region, naming this one.
label: ghost-seal/v1/home-region
